## What the original guide said

::: {.callout-note title="Archived explanation · not independently verified reporting"}
Removes charter requirements covering lowest-bid awards, tied bids, and certain contractor bonds, allowing these subjects to be governed through other rules. Removed provisions take effect by November 2028 unless replaced sooner.

**Original recommendation: YES.** This records Everett’s pre-election position, not the election result. The archive retains the full reasoning.
:::

[Read the ballot guide](../guide/index.qmd#question-e).

## Questions to follow
